name: report-diet
description: When a subagent is about to hand back a long report, it is held once and asked to write the full report to a file and return a short summary that ends with the file's path, so the parent's context stays small

enabled.title: Report diet
enabled.description: Off: subagents hand back their answers as they always do.

maxChars.title: Longest answer let through (characters)
maxChars.description: A subagent's final answer longer than this is held once. 200 to 100000.

summaryChars.title: Summary length (characters)
summaryChars.description: The most the summary asked for may be. 100 to 100000, and no more than the longest answer let through.

exclude.title: Subagent types to skip
exclude.description: Subagent types whose answers are never held, separated by commas. Explore and Plan are read-only (they cannot write the file) and their answers are meant to be read in full. Empty: none skipped.
